statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail has returned to the low band after the Nvidia result resolved benignly, though it stays above the prior night's baseline while the reopen gap is digested.
recommendation: Elevated attention is concentrated in the narrow 22:00-00:00 UTC window covering the reopened futures session and its digestion of the Nvidia result and conference call. Outside that window the mapped state reverts toward the calm baseline of the past night. The next checkpoint is the U.S. cash open at 13:30 UTC on Aug 27, the first cash auction to price the result. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain unchanged.
headline: Nvidia beat resolves the cycle's largest binary; futures reopen about 1% higher and Tail returns to the low band
body: The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed at 29,224.52, up 0.05%, inside a narrow 0.69% band of 29,096.84-29,296.77 after opening below the prior close at 29,130.77. That was a two-way, mean-reverting session with no directional efficiency. NVIDIA released fiscal Q2 2027 results at approximately 20:20 UTC: revenue $96.2bn, up 106% year on year against roughly $92.3bn consensus, data-centre revenue $89bn against roughly $85.4bn, earnings of $2.22 per share against $2.09, gross margin near 75%, and third-quarter guidance of $108bn plus or minus 2% against roughly $104bn consensus, with the outlook excluding China data-centre sales. CME equity futures were in their scheduled 21:00-22:00 UTC halt for the whole of the 21:00 UTC conference call, so the call was digested without a futures price path. Futures reopened with a gap: NQ September was quoted at 29,570.00, up 280.50 or 0.96% against the 29,289.50 settle, at 22:03 UTC on a delayed feed, inside a reopen band of 29,499.25-29,581.00 that already contains a two-way retracement. NVIDIA itself traded 217.70, up 3.83%, at 22:25 UTC after closing the cash session down 1.59%, a reversal rather than a one-way extension. Cross-assets are calm and unaligned: VIX closed 15.21, down 1.55%, at its session low; the H.15 release for Aug 25 shows the 2-year at 4.17% and the 10-year at 4.64%; WTI is 81.78, down 0.16%, and Brent 87.41, down 0.84%, with reported easing of Persian Gulf supply concerns removing an energy amplifier. Cash-session megacaps were split three higher and five lower, and the ex-NVIDIA semiconductor complex was firm but dispersed. Tail therefore eases from 21 to 18: the largest binary of the cycle resolved benignly, an observed retracement has already printed inside the reopen band, and no independent amplifier is aligned. It stays above the 10-12 baseline of the past night because the gap is fresh, the observed post-reopen path is only about 30 minutes long, and a delayed second leg remains credible while the full call is digested in thin overnight liquidity.

lookbackSummary: The past 24 hours ran a calm regime that tightened only at the very end. Tail held between 9 and 16 with the mapped state EA_ON/green from 22:00 UTC on Aug 25 through 19:00 UTC on Aug 26. Overnight and European hours were assessed as normal mode near Tail 11. The 12:00 UTC hour shifted to event/whipsaw at Tail 16 around the July PCE release, then decayed to mixed mode and Tail 10-11 through the afternoon while Stress climbed from 46 to 61 as positioning built into the Nvidia report. The 20:00 UTC hour moved to WATCH/yellow at Tail 21 and Stress 66 for the release window. No assessment was published for the 21:00 UTC clock hour, which is marked unavailable rather than reconstructed.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours are governed by one resolved catalyst and one open checkpoint. The Nvidia release and its conference call are behind the assessment, and the reopened futures session has repriced roughly 1% higher, so conditional Tail decays from 18 through Asian and European hours toward the 12-13 baseline that governed the prior night, assuming orderly discovery with visible retracements. European cash at 07:00 UTC is the second regional repricing and a modest checkpoint. Second-tier U.S. data at 12:30 UTC weighs on Stress and Confidence rather than Tail. The open checkpoint is the U.S. cash open at 13:30 UTC on Aug 27, the first cash auction to price the result against an observed overnight gap; conditional Tail returns to the watch band for that single hour as a checkpoint and not on observed structure, then decays again through the afternoon. The Jackson Hole symposium convenes on Aug 27 and the Fed chair keynote at 14:00 UTC on Aug 28 sits beyond this horizon, building as a background positioning input into the late U.S. session.
